### 🧩 Services

- ☎️ **AI Voice Agent Developer** — Inbound receptionists and outbound callers on VAPI and Retell, connected to Twilio, n8n and your calendar. They pick up every call, qualify the lead and put the appointment in the diary.
- 🤖 **AI Agent & Chatbot Developer** — Chat and email agents that answer from your own knowledge base (Supabase, RAG), draft replies for your team and hand off to a person when it matters.
- ⚙️ **n8n & Automation Developer** — n8n, Make.com and Zapier workflows that carry leads and data between your apps, from form fill to follow-up SMS, with no copy-pasting in between.
- 📇 **GoHighLevel & CRM Developer** — GoHighLevel, HubSpot, Zoho and Pipedrive set up to work for you: pipelines, lead routing, follow-up sequences and API integrations.
- 💻 **Claude Code Developer** — Full-stack apps built with Claude Code: command-center dashboards, custom CRMs and landing pages on React, Next.js and Supabase.
- 📊 **Data & Dashboard Developer** — Scrapers, pipelines and dashboards in Python, SQL, Power BI and Looker Studio that turn raw data into numbers you can act on.
